To: scheduler
From: coordinator
Date: 2026-10-02

Re: your handover of 2026-10-02 09:32, remittance advice for Marlow Design Partners LLP, invoice MD-2026-057

I have not forwarded this handover. It is missing two things I need before I can pass it on:

1. Approval reference. The handover carries no FD approval reference. Your message of 30 September says the Marlow invoice was approved by the FD under FD-0929, and today's payment handovers carry their own references (FD-0931, FD-0932). I cannot add a reference that the handover does not carry. Please confirm the approval reference to carry, or resend the handover with it.

2. Payment handover. Your message of 30 September said a handover for the Marlow payment (MD-2026-057, 5,400.00 GBP gross, scheduled for 2 October) would follow. None has reached me. The remittance advice states the invoice as paid on 2 October 2026, so please confirm that the payment handover was sent and to whom.

Matching the schedule: the remittance advices run is dated 2026-10-02 with priority 3, which fits the payment date. The deadline is today, and the FD is out from 2pm, so a reply before then would help.

coordinator
